 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_cov::alp_code_cg

Covergroup for C-PHY ALP code for CPHY v1.2.
covergroup alp_code_cg @ ( cphy_lane_xact_event ) ;
     type_option.comment = "CPHY :: Coverage for ALP code for CPHY v1.2.";
    option.per_instance = 1;
     alp_code_cp : coverpoint this.lane_xact.alp_code {
      bins STOP_CODE_bin = { 4'b0000};
      bins ULPS_CODE_bin = { 4'b0001};
      bins TRIG_1_CODE_bin = { 4'b0010};
      bins TRIG_2_CODE_bin = { 4'b0011};
      bins RESET_TRIG_CODE_bin = { 4'b0100};
      bins TRIG_3_CODE_bin = { 4'b0101};
      bins TRIG_4_CODE_bin = { 4'b0110};
      bins TRIG_5_CODE_bin = { 4'b0111};
      bins SPACER_CODE_bin = { 4'b1000};
      bins LPDT_START_CODE_bin = { 4'b1001};
      bins LPDT_NIBBLE_CODE_bin = { 4'b1010};
      bins POST_2_CODE_bin = { 4'b1011};
      option.weight = 1;
    }
  endgroup

    post_error_value : coverpoint rand_exc_xact.post_error_value iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::USER_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::RAND_POST_EOT_HS_ERROR) {
      bins post_error_value_0_bin= {0};
      bins post_error_value_1_bin= {1};
      bins post_error_value_2_bin= {2};
      bins post_error_value_3_bin= {3};
    }
    invalid_error_value : coverpoint rand_exc_xact.invalid_error_value iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_REQUEST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_PREPARE_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_RQST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_YIELD_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_RQST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_GO_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_CMD_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_IN_MARK_ERROR|| rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_POST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_MARK_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_PREAMBLE_CAL_VALUE) {
      bins invalid_error_value_0_bin= {3'b000};
      bins invalid_error_value_1_bin= {3'b001};
      bins invalid_error_value_2_bin= {3'b010};
      bins invalid_error_value_3_bin= {3'b011};
      bins invalid_error_value_4_bin= {3'b100};
      bins invalid_error_value_5_bin= {3'b101};
      bins invalid_error_value_6_bin= {3'b110};
      bins invalid_error_value_7_bin= {3'b111};
      ignore_bins ignore_invalid_error_value_0_bin= {3'b000} iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_REQUEST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_PREPARE_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_RQST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_YIELD_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_RQST_ERROR);
      ignore_bins ignore_invalid_error_value_1_bin= {3'b001} iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_REQUEST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_YIELD_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_RQST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_PREAMBLE_CAL_VALUE);
      ignore_bins ignore_invalid_error_value_4_bin= {3'b100} iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_LP_RQST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_IN_MARK_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_MARK_ERROR);
      ignore_bins ignore_invalid_error_value_7_bin= {3'b111} iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_GO_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_ESC_CMD_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_HS_POST_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_AFTER_MARK_ERROR);
    }
    undefined_cmd_error_value : coverpoint rand_exc_xact.cmd_error_value iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::RAND_CMD_VALUE_ESC_ERROR) {
      bins cmd_error_undefined_1_bin= {8'b10011111};
      bins cmd_error_undefined_2_bin= {8'b11011110};
    }
    num_invalid_entry_state_error_values : coverpoint rand_exc_xact.num_invalid_entry_state_error_values iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_IN_HS_ENTRY_MODE_ERROR || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_VALUE_IN_ESC_ENTRY_MODE_ERROR) {
      bins num_invalid_entry_state_min_bin= {[1 : 3]};
      bins num_invalid_entry_state_typ_bin= {[4 : 7]};
      bins num_invalid_entry_state_max_bin= {[8 : 10]};
    }
    drop_lpdt_bit : coverpoint rand_exc_xact.drop_lpdt_bit iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::DROP_BITS_IN_ESC_LPDT_BYTE_ERROR) {
      bins drop_lpdt_bit_min_bin= {8'h1};
      bins drop_lpdt_bit_typ_bin= {[8'h2 : 8'h6F]};
      bins drop_lpdt_bit_max_bin= {8'h7F};
    }
    preamble_error_in_symbols : coverpoint rand_exc_xact.preamble_error_in_symbols iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_PREAMBLE_CAL_VALUE) {
      bins preamble_error_min_bin= {[1 : 7]};
      bins preamble_error_typ_bin= {[ 7 + 1 : 1792 - 1]};
    }
    repeat_cal_error : coverpoint rand_exc_xact.repeat_cal_error iff (rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_PREAMBLE_CAL_VALUE || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_PREAMBLE_ALT_SEQ_CAL_PATTERN || rand_exc_xact.error_kind == svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_exception::INVALID_PREAMBLE_USER_SEQ_CAL_PATTERN) {
      bins repeat_cal_error_min_bin= {[1 : 7]};
      bins repeat_cal_error_typ_bin= {[ 7 + 1 : 1792 - 1]};
    }
  endgroup

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_cov::forward_escape_mode_type_field

Covergroup for C-PHY Escape mode transmission in Forward direction.
covergroup forward_escape_mode_type_field @ ( escape_xact_event ) ;
     type_option.comment = "CPHY :: Coverage for Escape mode transmission in forward direction.";
    option.per_instance = 1;
     forward_escape_mode_type_field : coverpoint this.lane_xact.esc_type {
      bins lpdt_bin = { 1};
      bins ulps_bin = { 3};
      // trigger_bin is exclude for CSI2 as it is not applicable.
      bins trigger_bin = { 2};
      ignore_bins ignore_trigger_bin = { 2} iff(this.cfg.forward_dir_esc_mode == svt_mipi_cphy_configuration::ULPS_FORWARD_ESC || this.cfg.forward_dir_esc_mode == svt_mipi_cphy_configuration::LPDT_ULPS_FORWARD_ESC);
      ignore_bins ignore_lpdt_bin = { 1} iff(this.cfg.forward_dir_esc_mode == svt_mipi_cphy_configuration::EVENTS_FORWARD_ESC || this.cfg.forward_dir_esc_mode == svt_mipi_cphy_configuration::ULPS_FORWARD_ESC);
      option.weight = 1;
    }
  endgroup

 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_cov::forward_transmission_modes_field

Covergroup for C-PHY Transmission mode in forward direction.
covergroup forward_transmission_modes_field @ ( cphy_lane_xact_event ) ;
     type_option.comment = "CPHY :: Coverage for Transmission modes in forward direction.";
    option.per_instance = 1;
     forward_transmission_modes_field: coverpoint this.lane_xact.transmission_mode {
      bins hs_bin = { 0};
      bins escape_bin = { 1};
      // turnaround_bin is excluded for both CSI2 and DSI as it is not applicable.
      bins turnaround_bin = { 2};

    }
  endgroup

      type_option.comment = "CPHY :: Coverage for Escape mode triggers in forward direction.";
    option.per_instance = 1;
       forward_trigger_type_field: coverpoint this.lane_xact.trigger {
      bins trigger_0_bin = { 1};
      // For DSI in forward direction trigger_0 is supported. Hence excluding the other coverbins.
      bins trigger_1_bin = { 2};

      bins trigger_3_bin = { 4};
      option.weight = 1;
    }

 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_cov::reverse_escape_type_field

Covergroup for C-PHY Escape mode transmission in Reverse direction.
covergroup reverse_escape_type_field @ ( escape_xact_event ) ;
     type_option.comment = "CPHY :: Coverage for Escape mode transmission in reverse direction.";
    option.per_instance = 1;
     reverse_escape_type_field : coverpoint this.lane_xact.esc_type {
      bins lpdt_bin = { 1};
      // ulps_bin is excluded for DSI in reverse direction as it is not supported.

 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_cov::reverse_transmission_modes_field

Covergroup for C-PHY Transmission mode in reverse direction.
covergroup reverse_transmission_modes_field @ ( cphy_lane_xact_event ) ;
     type_option.comment = "CPHY :: Coverage for Transmission modes in reverse direction.";
    option.per_instance = 1;
     reverse_transmission_modes_field: coverpoint this.lane_xact.transmission_mode {
      bins escape_bin = { 1};

  covergroup
 svt_mipi_cphy_lane_transaction_cov::reverse_trigger_type_field

Covergroup for C-PHY Escape mode entry commands (Triggers) in Reverse direction.
covergroup reverse_trigger_type_field @ ( escape_trigger_xact_event ) ;
      type_option.comment = "CPHY :: Coverage for Escape mode triggers in reverse direction.";
    option.per_instance = 1;
       reverse_trigger_type_field: coverpoint this.lane_xact.trigger {
      bins trigger_1_bin = { 2};

      // For DSI in reverse direction trigger_1 and trigger_2 are supported. Hence excluding the other coverbins.
      bins trigger_0_bin = { 1};
      bins trigger_3_bin = { 4};
      option.weight = 1;
    }
